mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, signaled by a positive YoY change in real GDP, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rising aggregate demand boosts corporate revenues and profits.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time when GDPC1 YoY growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, signaled by a 0.5% MoM decline in INDPRO, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions and falling output weigh on equity prices.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time following a 0.5% MoM drop in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, signaled by a 0.3 percentage point increase in UNRATE over 3 months, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as weakening labor market conditions signal a potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 55% of the time when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling housing starts and rising retail sales predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as the shift from residential investment to consumer spending boosts corporate revenues.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time when HOUST is declining and RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A high and rising CPI inflation rate, signaled by CPIAUCSL exceeding 3% YoY, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is likely to respond with monetary tightening that raises borrowing costs and compresses equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 55% of the time when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted unemployment rate - payroll employment spread, signaled by UNRATE rising above PAYEMS on a YoY percentage change basis, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as labor market deterioration signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time when the UNRATE-PAYEMS spread is inverted.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, signaled by a 1% MoM decline in RSAFS, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending retrenchment signals demand weakness.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive > 65% of the time following a 1% MoM drop in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A positive divergence between industrial production and payroll employment, with INDPRO rising faster than PAYEMS on a YoY basis, predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as productivity gains boost corporate profitability.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative > 45% of the time when INDPRO is outpacing PAYEMS on a YoY basis.
